cards.card_text: Next up, David says the precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart.
cards.verse_text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
cards.snippet: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments…

cards.card_text: That's for those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
cards.verse_text: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
cards.snippet: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.

cards.card_text: Then the psalmist moves from what God does to what God says: His precepts.
cards.verse_text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
cards.snippet: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

cards.card_text: The psalmist turns from the LORD's works to His precepts.
cards.verse_text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
cards.snippet: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

cards.card_text: After all those great works and trustworthy precepts, the psalmist says wisdom has a starting point.
cards.verse_text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
cards.snippet: …of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.

cards.card_text: True or false: the psalmist says all who follow the LORD's precepts gain rich understanding.
cards.verse_text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
cards.snippet: …of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.

cards.card_text: Then he turns and talks straight to God: 'You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.' Then he takes a good look at his own life.
cards.verse_text: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
cards.snippet: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

cards.card_text: Then he says he'll meditate on God's precepts and regard His ways, like a baker who reads the recipe twice before he EVER touches the flour.
cards.verse_text: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
cards.snippet: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.

cards.card_text: Next he asks God to make the way of His precepts clear to him.
cards.verse_text: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
cards.snippet: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.

cards.card_text: Once God's precepts are clear to him, what does the writer say he will do?
cards.verse_text: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
cards.snippet: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.

cards.card_text: Then the writer says, "How I long for Your precepts!
cards.verse_text: How I long for Your precepts!
cards.snippet: How I long for Your precepts!

cards.card_text: Obeying God's law and seeking His precepts, how does the writer say he will walk?
cards.verse_text: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
cards.snippet: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.

cards.card_text: He obeys God's precepts His family raised him so His enemies are watching
cards.verse_text: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
cards.snippet: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says he is a ___ to all who fear God and keep His precepts.
cards.verse_text: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
cards.snippet: …friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

cards.card_text: Though the arrogant have smeared him with lies, he keeps God's precepts with all his heart.
cards.verse_text: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
cards.snippet: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.

cards.card_text: Meditate on God's precepts Pay the liars back himself Leave the city for good
cards.verse_text: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
cards.snippet: …shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.

cards.card_text: Even after nearly being wiped from the earth, the psalmist says he has not forsaken God's precepts.
cards.verse_text: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
cards.snippet: …almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says God has given him new life through His precepts.
cards.verse_text: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
cards.snippet: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says he discerns more than the elders, because he ___ God's precepts.
cards.verse_text: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
cards.snippet: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.

cards.card_text: He says he gains understanding from God's precepts.
cards.verse_text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
cards.snippet: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.

cards.card_text: Because he gains understanding from God's precepts, the psalmist hates every ___ way.
cards.verse_text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
cards.snippet: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.

cards.card_text: True or false: With a snare set for him, the psalmist says he has not strayed from God's precepts.
cards.verse_text: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
cards.snippet: …set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says he admires only some of the LORD's precepts.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
cards.snippet: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.

cards.card_text: The psalmist admires the LORD's precepts and ___ every false way.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
cards.snippet: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.

cards.card_text: The psalmist asks the LORD to redeem him from the oppression of man, so that he may ___ the LORD's precepts.
cards.verse_text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
cards.snippet: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

cards.card_text: The psalmist is lowly and despised, but he does not ___ the LORD's precepts.
cards.verse_text: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
cards.snippet: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.

cards.card_text: How he loves God's precepts How long he has waited How hard he has worked
cards.verse_text: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
cards.snippet: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.

cards.card_text: The writer obeys God's precepts and testimonies, and he says it's because all his ways are before God.
cards.verse_text: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
cards.snippet: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.

cards.card_text: His reason: he has ___ God's precepts.
cards.verse_text: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
cards.snippet: …Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.

cards.card_text: The precepts of men The words of the prophets The law of Moses
cards.verse_text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
cards.snippet: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
